findings.title: Controlled evaluation framework is complete for the pre-feedback checkpoint
findings.summary: The current framework covers 50 paintings, 200 non-zero restoration cases, three fully evaluated restoration models, and one feasibility-audited model.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether this controlled subset is sufficient for the thesis scope before scaling.

findings.title: LaMa remains strongest under the refined reference-based metric policy
findings.summary: The refined comparison shows LaMa as the dominant model under the selected full-reference metrics and region policy.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether the majority-vote summary is an acceptable compact model-comparison result.

findings.title: Metric-region policy is a central methodological contribution
findings.summary: The framework distinguishes masked-region metrics from mask-bounding-box metrics. This prevents structurally inappropriate use of metrics such as SSIM on sparse masked pixels.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether the final metric-region policy should remain fixed for thesis experiments.

findings.title: Texture and brushstroke-proxy diagnostics add a local-structure layer
findings.summary: Notebook 31 adds texture and directional structure diagnostics, including GLCM, Gabor, and brushstroke-proxy features.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether these should be part of the core framework or treated as supplementary diagnostics.
findings.interpretation_boundary: Brushstroke-proxy metrics are not semantic brushstroke recognition or authentication.

findings.title: Stable Diffusion uncertainty heatmaps expose spatial instability
findings.summary: Notebook 32 converts multi-seed Stable Diffusion variation into spatial uncertainty heatmaps. This reveals where the generative model is unstable within and around damaged regions.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether the current 40-case subset is sufficient or should be expanded after feedback.
findings.interpretation_boundary: The heatmaps show seed-based spatial variability, not calibrated confidence.

findings.title: Case reports make aggregate findings inspectable
findings.summary: Notebook 33 creates selected per-case diagnostic reports combining visual outputs, refined metrics, texture diagnostics, and uncertainty heatmap evidence.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether selected case reports should be used as thesis evidence examples.

findings.title: The Streamlit dashboard is now a review interface for the framework
findings.summary: Notebook 34 prepares dashboard assets and the updated Streamlit app exposes model comparison, texture diagnostics, uncertainty diagnostics, and selected case reports.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Confirm whether the dashboard should remain a supporting artifact for the thesis.

findings.title: Scope expansion should wait until after supervisor feedback
findings.summary: Potential extensions include semantic/iconographic consistency checks, metadata-driven analysis, metric-policy ablation, scaling beyond 50 paintings, full uncertainty expansion, SDXL follow-up, and human/expert review.
findings.supervisor_decision_needed: Prioritize which extensions, if any, should be pursued after feedback.
